validation_items.accounting_standard: Residual Income = Operating Income - (Required Rate of Return x Average Operating Assets)
validation_items.analysis: Correct answers: (1) RI encourages accepting projects above required return - CORRECT (unlike ROI which rejects projects below current ROI but above hurdle); (2) RI charges divisions for assets employed - CORRECT (required return x assets is the charge); (4) RI avoids rejecting investments that lower ROI but exceed required return - CORRECT (this is the core advantage). Excluded: (3) 'It always increases when assets increase' is FALSE - RI only increases if new assets generate returns exceeding the hurdle rate.

validation_items.accounting_standard: ASC 855 Subsequent Events: Type I (recognized) if condition existed at balance sheet date; Type II (disclosed only) if condition arose after
validation_items.analysis: Correct: 'Recognized subsequent event requiring adjustment' because the customer's financial distress existed at year-end, making the post-year-end bankruptcy additional evidence about a pre-existing condition (Type I event per ASC 855). Distractors all plausible: (B) nonrecognized/disclosed only (Type II - wrong because condition pre-existed); (C) ignored (violates ASC 855 evaluation requirement); (D) reported in OCI (misapplies ASC 220 - bad debts flow through income statement).
validation_items.cma_part_1_scope: Yes - Section A: External Financial Reporting Decisions

validation_items.accounting_standard: ASC 305 / SFAS 95: Cash equivalents are highly liquid investments with original maturity <= 3 months (90 days)
validation_items.analysis: Correct: 88 days < 90 days threshold, so 'Cash equivalent' is correct. Distractors: (B) inventory (T-bills are not goods held for sale - ASC 330 inapplicable); (C) operating receivable (not from customer sales - ASC 310 inapplicable); (D) long-term investment (88-day instrument is short-term). All distractors plausible and well-explained.
validation_items.cma_part_1_scope: Yes - Section A: External Financial Reporting Decisions

validation_items.analysis: FIFO below NRV→Write down inventory (ASC 330); ARO PV→Record liability + add to asset cost (ASC 410); 88-day T-bill→Cash equivalent (ASC 305); Equipment purchase→Investing cash outflow (ASC 230). All pairings correct.
validation_items.cma_part_1_scope: Yes - Section A: External Financial Reporting Decisions
